channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Nvidia agrees to proposed $290 million crypto mining settlement
item.description: Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang agreed to a proposed $290 million cash settlement in a shareholder case over crypto mining disclosures; a judge must approve it.

item.title: Polygon bridge: Add Polygon to MetaMask before bridging?
item.description: Do you need to add Polygon to MetaMask before bridging? No. Deposit on Ethereum first, then add Polygon PoS to MetaMask to see and use your tokens there.

item.title: How do liquidity providers earn money: bridge fees explained
item.description: Liquidity providers earn money from crypto bridges mainly through transfer fees, while token incentives can add income; pool volume and deposit size shape each provider’s share.

item.title: Exact-Input vs Exact-Output Swap Quotes: What Moves
item.description: Exact input vs exact output swap quotes fix opposite amounts: one fixes what you send, the other what arrives, with slippage applied to the amount left variable.

item.title: How do you track an Ethereum-to-Solana transfer on Wormholescan?
item.description: To track a transfer on Wormholescan, search your source transaction hash and follow it from finality through VAA signing to redemption on the destination chain.

item.title: How to Recover Tokens Sent on the Wrong Network
item.description: Sent tokens on the wrong network? Recover them yourself when you control the receiving wallet; contact the exchange or contract owner when they control the address.

item.title: How does Aave work for beginners? Aave V3 lending
item.description: How does Aave work for beginners? Aave pools pay suppliers in aTokens; borrowers post collateral, pay variable interest and risk liquidation below health factor 1.

item.title: Aave staking: What triggers a slash and who pays
item.description: Aave staking slashing is automatic in Umbrella and limited to the matching asset pool; legacy Safety Module cuts required governance approval.

item.title: DeFi vaults: how deposits become shares
item.description: What is a vault in DeFi in simple terms? It pools one asset, follows a strategy and issues shares that represent a changing claim on the pool over time.

item.title: High slippage tolerance sets your worst allowed price
item.description: Does high slippage tolerance mean you get the worst price? No: it sets your swap’s minimum output; the pool sets execution, which you can verify on-chain.

item.title: SunSwap V2 or V3 when you want to leave a pool alone
item.description: SunSwap V2 vs V3 pool choice comes down to your pair and attention: V2 suits a hands-off deposit; V3 suits a range you can monitor and adjust.

item.title: EU proposal targets 60 Russian banks and crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal would target 60 banks and crypto networks, but needs unanimous approval from all 27 EU states.

item.title: EU proposes crypto crackdown in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission proposed targeting 60 Russian banks and crypto networks in a new Russia sanctions package, but all 27 EU states must approve it.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks in 22nd Russia sanctions
item.description: The European Commission proposed its 22nd Russia sanctions package on Nov. 23, targeting crypto and payment networks alongside 60 banks, with approval still pending.

item.title: Aave opens savings app after early access tops $63 million
item.description: Aave Labs opened its savings app to the public after early-access balances exceeded $63 million, with bank links and onchain lending behind the account balance.

item.title: Liquidity position: a lower APR alone is no reason to exit
item.description: Should I exit my liquidity position when the APR drops? Exit only when lower expected fees lose to a better option after exit and re-entry costs over your holding period.

item.title: Smart Contract Cross-Chain Messages: Celer’s Receiver Checks
item.description: A smart contract receives a cross-chain message through MessageBus signature checks, then verifies the source chain and sender before acting on the payload.

item.title: How much collateral is needed for a crypto loan? Estimate yours
item.description: How much collateral is needed for a crypto loan? Divide the loan by its LTV for the minimum value, then add a buffer for price moves and growing debt.

item.title: CoW Swap order UID: digest, owner and expiry
item.description: What is inside a DEX order UID? CoW Swap packs a 32-byte EIP-712 digest, 20-byte owner address and 4-byte validTo expiry into 56 bytes.

item.title: TWAMM long-term order: Choose a window that meets your deadline
item.description: Choose a TWAMM long-term order duration by dividing order size by hours, comparing that rate with normal pair volume, then checking your deadline.
